a:r.a:t: To establish market dominance in hybrid cloud consulting,
hybrid cloud solutions must address two challenges:
Help clients address
complexity of Chapter 2
cloud modernization
Chapter 2 requirements:
Mission-critical middleware, databases and existing apps make up ~60% of the opportunity; bulk of growth will be funded through digital acceleration (80%)
Containerization to increase substantially: ~45%-50% rewrites
and ~65% net new
Simplify and accelerate solutioning and delivery
at global scale
Proposal development relies heavily on a few local experts with multiple handoffs to different SMEs—time consuming and not scalable
Delivery driven by aggregation of best practices, offering content in scope, assets and methods; relying primarily on skills of resources available, leading to inconsistency and higher risk exposure
Limited reuse and harvesting of content development by proposal and client delivery teams globally

a:r.a:t: Our actions
In 2021, we introduced hybrid cloud journeys to capture Chapter 2 workloads on the Red Hat® OpenShift® platform: middleware, databases and Microsoft applications
Now we’re expanding hybrid cloud journeys to support migrations and app modernization, and to build on IBM Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Also strengthening capabilities to accelerate existing mainframe modernization
Through the introduction of the Hybrid Cloud Workbench:
Accelerate discovery, sizing, solutioning and proposal generation, and guided low-touch delivery with codified assets and accelerators, driving consistency and predictability in outcomes
Improve co-creation and reuse of assets through crowdsourcing across clients, acquisitions, partners and open source
Improve branding of Hybrid Cloud Workbench to differentiate against Accenture myNav, Deloitte innoWake, TCS MasterCraft and other competitors
